::: {.obsidian-offer-letter}
:::

State the offer in the first paragraph. Name the position, the
start date, and the reporting line.

# Salary and benefits

State the salary, the benefits, and any bonus or commission
arrangements.

# Conditions

State the conditions attached to the offer. Name any pre-employment
checks, the probation period, and the right to withdraw the offer.

# Acceptance

State how the candidate accepts the offer and the deadline. Give
the contact for questions.

# Post-acceptance steps

List the steps after acceptance: contracts, right to work checks,
and the onboarding process.
